_comment: Data-driven config for the jobs app sidecar + frontend. port is jobs-sidecar.ps1's default listen port. Copy jobs.config.local.example.json to jobs.config.local.json to override any of this per-machine (paths, port, ADO org). Adding a repo or a link is a data edit, not a code change.
_adoComment: Azure DevOps wiring for the Assigned (ADO) mode. The sidecar shells out to `az` (inheriting the signed-in user's cached creds) and shapes your current-sprint work. currentSprintTeam is the only fixed string az needs; the iteration path is resolved live so it keeps working next sprint. org/project/url templates keep link-building data-driven. Set these to your own org, or leave ADO mode unused — the board works without it.
_prCheckComment: Cadence for the background PR-status sweep (check-pr-status.ps1), fired from the sidecar's main request loop. intervalSec is the chosen cadence, not a placeholder.
_almanacComment: Opt-in button linking to a personal daily read served at /almanac/latest.html. Off here deliberately: this repo is meant to be shareable and the Almanac is a private thing, so a clone gets a board with no trace of it. Turn it on per-machine in the gitignored jobs.config.local.json.
_reposComment: Repos a job can be pinned to. Jobs store the repo KEY; the sidecar resolves path + trunk here for the git-graph endpoints (also read by audit-done-jobs.ps1). trunk = the branch to diff a feature branch against (merge-base..branch). Empty by default: register yours from the repo dropdown's '+ Add repo' (it writes to the gitignored jobs.config.local.json), or hand-edit that file using jobs.config.local.example.json as the shape.
